body_html:
@karenatsharon https://twitter.com/karenatsharon/status/1228757501392412679
When seas of eternity dry up
has your soul found refuge
in a tidal pool,
a buttercup
stretching fortune
upon tickling rain
of a summer's eve
dripping memories
or do
memories
trap thee
in a depth worse than
death?
